description: Encode text to Morse code and decode it back, with a WebAudio Play button that sounds out the dits and dahs.

faqs.a: International Morse: A–Z, 0–9 and common punctuation like . , ? ! / @ are all mapped.
Letters are separated by spaces and words by / so decoding is unambiguous.
The Play button uses the Web Audio API to beep dots (short) and dashes (long) at 600 Hz. Some browsers require a user click first, which the button provides.
faqs.q: Why does Play need a click?

howto: Type or paste text into the input box.
Choose Encode (text → Morse) or Decode (Morse → text).
Press Convert to see the result, or Play to hear it.
Use Copy to grab the output.
title: Morse Code Translator
